ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a one-row data table, with the headers in order being f(2), g(2), f'(2), g'(2), and the corresponding data in order being 10, 3, 5, 7. Therefore read off f(2)=10, g(2)=3, f'(2)=5, g'(2)=7. Reasoning: The problem asks for the slope of the tangent line to f(x)/g(x) at x=2, which is to find the derivative of the quotient function at x=2. By the quotient rule, (f/g)'(2) = [g(2)f'(2) - f(2)g'(2)]/[g(2)]^2. Substituting the values in the table gives [3·5 - 10·7]/3^2 = (15-70)/9 = -55/9.
